assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and episodes of dizziness that have persisted despite initial evaluation, raising concern for an underlying arrhythmia.
The symptoms are intermittent and their exact timing is elusive.
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated to capture the elusive nature of these symptoms and correlate them with cardiac rhythm disturbances.
CPT 93247 corresponds to long-term continuous ECG monitoring.
The denial reason code is PR-204.
The denial stated this procedure is not covered under the member's current benefit plan.
